messages:
Evan (Sales): Customer (defense contractor) asked if we can run a 3-node islanded POC in a classified air-gapped site. Must use on-prem HSM, no outbound, courier-delivered media, and they'd like a proposed upgrade cadence. Thoughts?
Maya (Solutions Eng): Not a blocker. Need HSM model (Thales Luna or YubiHSM), who holds signing keys, and whether they want full bundles or delta patches only. Also confirm whether any FIPS requirements.
Evan (Sales): They said Thales, internal PKI will sign activation tokens, and they prefer USB sticks for initial bundle then signed deltas on subsequent couriers. FIPS yes.
Diego (SRE): We support Thales. Our offline flow verifies signed manifests against customer CA and enforces FIPS ciphers. We can produce detached delta patches; typical delta size ~40-250MB depending on model changes. Must define scheduled secure windows for patching.
Maya (Solutions Eng): Ops snippet for their playbook: ```bash
# verify manifest & signature
openssl dgst -sha256 -verify /etc/pki/customer_root.pem -signature bundle.sig bundle.tar.gz
sha256sum bundle.tar.gz | cut -d' ' -f1
./rwdctl bootstrap --bundle bundle.tar.gz --activation /mnt/usb/activation.jwt
```
Nina (AE): Pricing for presales: 4-week POC PS = $30,000, airgap packaging & signing = $5,000, HSM integration validation = $7,500. We'll credit PS on conversion to Dedicated.
Compliance (Legal): Security questionnaire hotspots: telemetry off-by-default, SBOM per bundle, signed provenance for deltas, CVE remediation timelines for air-gapped installs, indemnity clauses around offline data leakage. We'll draft responses but CVE SLA needs negotiation (immediate remediation unrealistic without physical patching).
Diego (SRE): Recommend contract language: quarterly scheduled patch windows + emergency hotfix courier process (signed hotfix + verification steps). Also offer a rollback plan and reproducible hashes in SBOM.
InfraBot: Generated signed-manifest v3.4 (ed25519) and delta package skeleton created (internal).
Maya (Solutions Eng): Deliverables I'll prepare: 1) airgap install/runbook E2E, 2) delta acceptance test plan, 3) sample activation token workflow for their PKI, 4) suggested patch cadence wording. Can have drafts by EOD tomorrow.
Evan (Sales): Customer asked for kickoff next Thu AM. Can Legal aim to return questionnaire answers by Tue noon? We'll send proposal Wed.
Compliance (Legal): Tue noon doable for initial draft; will flag remediation timeline as exception.
Nina (AE): I'll tentatively reserve engineering PS slots and prepare the proposal template.
Evan (Sales): Great — I'll confirm node counts and expected QPS (they said ~120 rps short sequences) and loop everyone in once confirmed. :thumbsup:
